# pantechdynamics_image (Data Source)

Looks up one operating system image by slug. Use it to fail early on a wrong slug, and to read the zones the image can be used in. Use pantechdynamics_images to list them all.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look one image up by slug, and check it can be used in the zone you create in.
data "pantechdynamics_image" "ubuntu" {
  slug = "ubuntu-24-04"
}

output "ubuntu_zones" {
  value = data.pantechdynamics_image.ubuntu.zones
}

# The encrypted variant of Ubuntu 24.04. The lookup fails when encrypted VMs are
# not enabled for your organization, before anything is ordered.
data "pantechdynamics_image" "ubuntu_encrypted" {
  slug = "ubuntu-24-04-encrypted"
}

output "ubuntu_encrypted_zones" {
  value = data.pantechdynamics_image.ubuntu_encrypted.zones
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `slug` (String) Slug of the image to look up, for example "ubuntu-24-04". It must match exactly. The lookup fails if no image has it.

### Read-Only

- `encrypted` (Boolean) True for an encrypted image: the instance's disk, its snapshots and backups are encrypted at rest, each instance with its own key. Encrypted images are listed only once encrypted VMs are enabled for your organization (on request).
- `encrypted_variant_of` (String) On an encrypted image, the slug of the plain image it is the encrypted variant of, for example "ubuntu-24-04" for "ubuntu-24-04-encrypted". Null on a plain image.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the image.
- `name` (String) Operating system name, for example Ubuntu.
- `version` (String) Operating system version, for example 24.04 LTS.
- `zones` (List of String) Zones the image can be used in.
